 SAVE THE DATE: EAST COAST CREDIT UNION ICE FESTIVAL 
 The East Coast Credit Union Ice Festival is back and bigger than ever from January 29-February 7, 2027.
 From January 29-31 you can expect a similar experience to what you know and love (with some fun, new surprises of course) - live ice carving, a street party on Saturday, music, games, business specials and lots more fun!
 The following weekend, we are expanding to include a Winter Lights Celebration! There will be a number of new light installations throughout downtown Dartmouth, and an incredible light projection show inside Christ Church.
 There are many more details to come, but mark your calendars!!
